title: Enhancement: Enable kdump on Nexthop devices
author: domingo-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

To enable kdump to capture core dumps on Nexthop devices. This will help improve debuggability.

### Current Behavior

Kdump is not enabled on all Nexthop devices

### Proposed Behavior

Kdump is enabled on all Nexthop devices

linkedPullRequests.title: Enable kdump on Nexthop devices
linkedPullRequests.author: domingo-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

To enable kdump to capture core dumps on Nexthop devices. This will help improve debuggability.

NH-5010 already has kdump enabled in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/24169

Fixes #26134

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

By reserving memory for the crash kernel.

#### How to verify it

- install image
- verify kdump is enabled
- Trigger a kernel panic
- Verify core dumps and kernel logs are captured
